battle.name: 下加拿大叛亂
battle.theater: 里歇利耶河谷與蒙特利爾
battle.brief: 一八三七年十一月起，下加拿大愛國者起事，先在聖丹尼擊敗政府軍，隨後在聖夏爾與聖厄斯達什連遭挫敗。十二月十四日聖厄斯達什之戰，英軍以砲火燒毀教堂與莊宅，陳尼爾當陣亡，愛國者武力在里歇利耶河谷崩解。一八三八年春再度起事，入秋轉為跨境入侵，十一月平定。野砲自始至終是英方決定勝負的火力。

kit.name: 野砲
kit.history: 能拆成幾件馬車拉走的砲。它讓野戰第一次有了可以計算的砲火。

countries: 下加拿大叛亂是英屬北美兩場起事中規模較大、鎮壓較酷的一場，交戰一方是英國與下加拿大殖民政府，另一方是愛國者運動及其在美國境內的武裝組織。英方由總督與行政局、立法局構成，總督一八三一年至三八年是喬治·韋瑟羅爾，一八三八年一月起是科林·坎貝爾，司法與行政的實權在「城堡集團」手裡；武力方面是駐紮的英國正規軍分遣隊，第一團與第三十二團等步兵在聖厄斯達什一役中作戰，第三十二團的軍官在戰鬥中陣亡，另有新到的第八十三團、殖民地民兵團、徵召的保王派義勇，以及從安大略與新斯科舍抽調的分遣隊與皇家海軍的艦隊武裝；紐約州政府一度默許越境武裝，但同時以違反中立法拘押羅伯特·納爾松等首領。英方的指揮體系在這一年換了兩次：韋瑟羅爾在聖丹尼與聖夏爾連敗後被召回，實際作戰由陸軍中校查爾斯·戈爾與後來接任司法長官的約翰·科爾伯恩主持。愛國者一方沒有國家與編制：它是一個由議員、律師、醫生、農民與獵戶組成的政治運動，領袖包括路易·約瑟夫·帕皮諾、讓·奧利維耶·陳尼爾、沃爾弗雷德·納爾松、阿穆里·吉羅、托馬斯·斯托羅·布朗、費爾迪南·奧克洛夫斯基與弗朗索瓦·洛里米耶，一八三八年又加入英裔醫生羅伯特·納爾松。運動在全國設有自由之子社等秘密組織，鄉村裡的隊伍靠自備獵槍、舊步槍與長矛作戰，另有從美國越境而來的武裝。
countriesEn: The Lower Canada Rebellion was the larger and the more harshly suppressed of the two risings in British North America. One side was Britain and the colonial government of Lower Canada; the other was the Patriote movement and its armed organisations on the American side of the border. The British side was built on the governor, the executive council and the legislative council: the governor was George Wetherall from 1831 to 1838 and Colin Campbell from January 1838, and the real weight of administration and justice lay with the English-speaking oligarchy known as the Château Clique. Its military strength consisted of detachments of British regulars, the 1st and 32nd Regiments of Foot among them, the 32nd losing an officer in the fighting, together with the newly arrived 83rd Regiment, the colonial militia regiments, the recruited loyalist volunteers, detachments drawn from Upper Canada and Nova Scotia, and the naval detachments of the Royal Navy. The government of New York for a while looked the other way at armed men crossing the border, while at the same time arresting leaders such as Robert Nelson for violating the Neutrality Act. The British command changed hands twice in the year. Wetherall was recalled after his defeats at Saint-Denis and Saint-Charles, and the fighting was directed in practice by Lieutenant-Colonel Charles Gore and then by John Colborne, who afterwards succeeded to the office of Chief Justice. The Patriote side had no state and no establishment: it was a political movement of members of parliament, lawyers, doctors, farmers and hunters, led by Louis-Joseph Papineau, Jean-Olivier Chénier, Wolfred Nelson, Amury Girod, Thomas Storrow Brown, Ferdinand Oklowski and François-Marie-Thomas Chevalier de Lorimier, with the English-speaking physician Robert Nelson joining them in 1838. The movement built secret societies such as the Fils de la Liberté across the province, village bands fought with their own hunting rifles, old muskets and pikes, and armed men continued to arrive from the United States.
people: 路易·約瑟夫·帕皮諾是這場運動的政治領袖，他以選舉議員與議會領袖的身份經營愛國者黨三十年，一八三四年把九十二條決議案提交立法議會，要求殖民地對議會負責。一八三七年十一月起事爆發時，他人在英國與美國遊說，沒有親自上陣；一八三八年二月愛國者高層在美國商議成立臨時政府時，他反對倉促跨境，自己始終留在加拿大，把武裝領導權留給了別人，這個分歧日後成了追責的材料。真正指揮第一線的是讓·奧利維耶·陳尼爾，這位醫生以聖厄斯達什為據點，集結了原本指望八百人、實際只得到二百零一名武裝者的隊伍，把防禦佈置在教堂、修道院、神父住宅與莊宅之中；十二月十四日英軍砲火把建築點燃，他在窗口企圖突圍時陣亡。托馬斯·斯托羅·布朗是報人與組織者，他領導的隊伍在十一月二十五日的聖夏爾被擊潰，約二百五十人對四百零六名正規步兵與二十名民兵騎兵加兩門砲，托馬斯·斯托羅·布朗本人在戰後逃亡。沃爾弗雷德·納爾松在十一月二十三日取得愛國者唯一一次勝利：他與六十名武裝不佳的居民把正規軍三百人與一門砲擋在石屋外，砲彈打在石牆上無效、側翼攻擊又被裝備較差的民兵頂回，英軍彈盡後撤退，砲也丟在了那裡。英方最關鍵的人是查爾斯·戈爾中校，他兩度率隊出擊、兩度敗績；接替他的是約翰·科爾伯恩，他指揮聖厄斯達什的包圍作戰，事後主持對愛國者首腦的軍法審訊，被判刑者中有沃爾弗雷德·納爾松與讓·菲利普·布歇－貝勒維爾，最終有二十九人被判絞刑、五十八人被流放澳洲。英裔醫生羅伯特·納爾松是英方通緝名單上的人物，也是分裂愛國者陣營的關鍵人物，他在美國阿爾堡宣布成立下加拿大共和國並被美軍拘押，最終獲得陪審團無罪。一八三八年秋，芬蘭－瑞典出身的尼爾斯·冯·舒爾茨被選為新政府的軍隊總司令，隨後在美加邊境被捕並被處絞刑。
peopleEn: Louis-Joseph Papineau was the political leader of the movement. He had headed the Patriote party for thirty years as an elected member and the leader of the assembly, and in 1834 laid the Ninety-Two Resolutions before the House of Assembly, asking that the colony be made accountable to it. When the rising broke out in November 1837 he was canvassing in Britain and the United States and did not take the field himself; in February 1838, when the Patriote leadership in the United States discussed setting up a provisional government, he objected to a premature crossing and stayed in Canada, leaving the direction of the fighting to others, and that division was later used against him. The man who actually commanded in the field was Jean-Olivier Chénier, a physician who made Saint-Eustache his base, gathered the two hundred and one men who actually turned up instead of the eight hundred expected, and placed his defence in the church, the convent, the rectory and the manor house. On 14 December the British artillery set the buildings alight and he was killed trying to escape from a window. Thomas Storrow Brown was the journalist and organiser whose force was broken at Saint-Charles on 25 November, roughly two hundred and fifty men against four hundred and six regular infantry, twenty militia cavalrymen and two guns; Brown himself escaped. Wolfred Nelson won the only Patriote victory on 23 November: with sixty badly armed villagers he held three hundred regulars and a gun off in a stone house, the shot having no effect against the walls and a flanking attempt turned back by the less well-armed militia, and the British retired when their ammunition ran out, leaving the gun behind. The most important British officer was Lieutenant-Colonel Charles Gore, who twice led a column out and twice was beaten; John Colborne took over, directed the encirclement at Saint-Eustache and afterwards sat on the court martial of the Patriote leaders, among them Wolfred Nelson and the journalist Jean-Philippe Boucher-Belleville, ending in twenty-nine executions and the transportation of fifty-eight men to Australia. Robert Nelson, an English-speaking physician, was on the wanted list and was also the man who split the Patriote movement: he proclaimed the Republic of Lower Canada at Alburg in the United States, was arrested there by the United States Army and was finally acquitted by a sympathetic jury. In the autumn of 1838 the Finnish-Swedish soldier Nils von Schoultz was chosen as commander of the army of the new government; he was later arrested on the border and hanged.
kits: 野砲在這場叛亂裡始終站在決定性的一端，但它始終由英方掌握。三場決定性會戰裡都出現了火砲，而每一次的表現都說明輕型野砲在城市聚落裡的用法與限制：在十一月二十三日的聖丹尼，戈爾只帶了一門砲，三次對著俯瞰道路的石屋直射，砲彈打在石牆上無效，英軍側翼攻擊又被裝備較差的民兵頂回，最後不是被砲火擊敗，而是彈藥耗盡而退，砲也丟在了那裡；十一月二十五日的聖夏爾，政府軍以四百零六名正規步兵、二十名民兵騎兵與兩門砲對上二百五十名武裝者與五十支步槍，兩小時的戰鬥以愛國者五十六人陣亡告終；十二月十四日的聖厄斯達什，砲火被用在最有效果的地方：科爾伯恩在正午下令砲兵向村中心直射，第一團的兩個連攻入神父住宅並放火、第一團的擲雷兵攻入莊宅並放火，再從側門進入教堂並縱火，砲火把整條主街與教堂內外打成一片火海，躲在裡面的愛國者從窗口跳下時被直射火力打倒，陳尼爾便死在這個位置。英方砲兵用的是當時殖民地與正規軍通用的輕型野砲：幾磅到十幾磅口徑，銅或鐵質身管，架在輕型車上，砲身與砲架可拆，由一匹或兩匹馬拖行，因此能沿里歇利耶河谷的土路快速調動，這正是野砲相對固定砲壘的價值所在。愛國者一方沒有成建制的火砲，武器是自備的獵槍、老式步槍與長矛；自由之子社的象徵正是長矛，在一八三二年蒙特利爾槍擊事件之後，長矛成了愛國者的標誌與街頭的武裝，志願者用它對付騎兵與鎮壓的義勇。一八三八年春天的拉卡托訖與聖夏爾兩役，雙方的差距仍然由同一件事決定：政府一方有幾門可以隨身移動的野砲與受過訓練的砲手，愛國者一方仍只有散兵式的獵槍。
kitsEn: The field gun stood at the decisive end of this rebellion throughout, though it was always in British hands. Guns appeared in all three of the decisive actions, and each time they showed both the use and the limits of the light field piece in a built-up village. At Saint-Denis on 23 November Gore brought only one gun: he fired it three times at the stone house that overlooked the road, the shot had no effect against the walls, his flanking attempt was turned back by the less well-armed militia, and the British retired not because of the gun fire but because the ammunition ran out, leaving the gun behind them. At Saint-Charles on 25 November the government brought four hundred and six regular infantry, twenty militia cavalrymen and two guns against two hundred and fifty men with fifty rifles, and after two hours of fighting the Patriote dead numbered fifty-six. At Saint-Eustache on 14 December the artillery was used where it told: Colborne ordered the guns to fire on the centre of the village at noon, two companies of the 1st Regiment took the rectory and set it on fire, the grenadiers of the 1st took the manor and set that on fire as well, and the church was then entered through the vestry and fired from within. The gun fire turned the main street and the interior of the church into a sheet of flame, and the men sheltering inside were shot as they jumped from the windows; Chénier was killed at that moment. The British gunners used the light field pieces standard to colonies and regular armies alike: pieces of a few pounds up to a dozen or so, of brass or iron, on light carriages, the barrel and carriage separable, drawn by one horse or a pair, and therefore able to move quickly along the dirt roads of the Richelieu valley, which was precisely the field gun's advantage over a fixed battery. The Patriotes had no formed artillery at all. Their weapons were their own hunting rifles, old muskets and pikes; the pike was the emblem of the Fils de la Liberté, and after the shooting of demonstrators at Montreal in 1832 the pike became both the badge of the Patriotes and a street weapon, carried by volunteers to meet cavalry and the volunteers of the government. In the actions at Lac-à-la-Tortue and Saint-Charles in the spring of 1838 the same asymmetry decided the result: on the government side a few field guns that could be moved with the column and crews who had been trained to serve them, on the Patriote side only hunting guns in the hands of scattered bands.
tactics: 下加拿大的起事是一場以村莊為單位的防禦戰，愛國者的戰術建立在對本地地形與民情的熟悉上，但缺少能持續作戰的組織。十月起，愛國者在里歇利耶河谷沿線的村莊徵集武裝，築起街垒，把教堂、修道院與莊宅作為據點，把長矛隊與獵槍隊分開配置：戈爾在聖丹尼進攻石屋時，先以砲火試探，再用側翼包抄，正是這套分進合擊的路數。英方的戰術是英式野戰的翻版：先以少量分遣隊與民兵守住要道與渡口，切斷鄉村武裝與城鎮的聯繫，再用分隊縱隊與密集射擊消滅村內的守軍，最後以砲火與縱火摧毀據點的遮蔽物，迫使其在火中自行潰散；聖厄斯達什一役中，攻方先奪神父住宅放煙、再奪莊宅放火、最後由側門縱火攻入教堂，步步為營，把一條主街變成縱火的通道。愛國者的弱點在於一旦首領陣亡或彈藥耗盡就沒有替代的指揮：陳尼爾在聖厄斯達什當陣亡後，該區的抵抗立刻瓦解；布朗在聖夏爾戰敗後，同樣沒有力量再集結。一八三八年改為跨境作戰後，戰術變成游擊與小股襲擊：以漁民與走私船把武器與人員送過界河，在夜間進入村莊破壞道路、徵集物資，再退回美國；一八三八年十一月初的大舉入侵因準備不足而在登陸與補給環節上就失敗了。鎮壓方在軍事之外還有另一套手段：全面搜查、逮捕與沒收，軍法法庭與民政法庭並行，最終把數百名被捕者判流澳洲——這一套把起事從戰場上徹底移走，也是這場叛亂與上加拿大叛亂在結局上最大的不同。
tacticsEn: The Lower Canada rising was a war of village defence. The Patriote method grew out of intimate knowledge of the local terrain and the local people, but it lacked any organisation capable of fighting for long. From October the Patriotes raised bands along the villages of the Richelieu valley, threw up barricades and made the church, the convent and the manor houses into strongpoints, keeping pike and rifle parties separate. The attack on the stone house at Saint-Denis followed exactly that logic: the gun was tried first and the flank was turned afterwards. The British method was the English pattern of war translated to the woods. Small detachments and militia held the roads and the ferries first, cutting the villages off from the towns; columns of regulars with close fire were then worked into the villages to break the defenders in the open; and last the guns and the fire were used to destroy the cover of the strongpoints and force the garrisons to break up in the flames. At Saint-Eustache the attackers took the rectory first to raise smoke, took the manor next, and then fired the church from the vestry, working forward step by step and turning a single main street into a channel of fire. The weakness of the Patriotes was that once a leader was killed or the ammunition ran out there was no substitute command: when Chénier fell at Saint-Eustache the resistance of that whole district came apart at once, and after the defeat at Saint-Charles Brown had no strength left to rally. From 1838 the war became a cross-border campaign of raids and small incursions: fishermen and smuggling boats carried men and weapons across the boundary river, the villages were entered at night to cut roads and take stores, and the bands withdrew again into the United States; the large invasion of early November 1838 failed at the stage of landing and supply. The repression had a second set of instruments alongside the military one: searches, arrests and confiscations, a court martial running in parallel with the civil courts, and sentences of transportation to Australia for hundreds of those arrested. That apparatus removed the rising from the battlefield altogether, and it is the largest difference between the outcome here and that of the rebellion in Upper Canada.
data: 可核對的數字大致如下。時間跨度：下加拿大叛亂自一八三七年十一月六日爆發，至一八三八年十一月十日；下加拿大共和國存在於一八三八年二月二十二日至十一月九日之間。聖丹尼之戰（1837年11月23日）：英軍三百名正規軍與一門砲，愛國者二百名民兵與六百名武裝不佳的居民；英軍六人陣亡、十人受傷、六人失蹤，並丟失一門砲，愛國者十二人陣亡、七人受傷。聖夏爾之戰（1837年11月25日）：政府軍四百零六名正規步兵、二十名民兵騎兵與兩門砲，愛國者二百至二百五十人與五十支步槍；英軍三人陣亡、十八人受傷，愛國者五十六人陣亡；戰鬥歷時約兩小時。聖厄斯達什之戰（1837年12月14日）：政府軍約一千五百人，含第一團與第三十二團的一千二百八十名正規軍、新到的第八十三團、砲兵與二百二十名保王派義勇；愛國者實際只集合了二百零一人；英軍三人陣亡，愛國者七十人陣亡、一百二十人被俘，作戰歷時至少四小時。全戰線的總數：英方常備軍一千三百八十人，到一八三八年年中增至約一萬人，另有三萬三千名殖民地民兵；愛國者方面有武裝者約四千一百人，另有約二萬五千人的同情者民兵。鎮壓的數字：蒙利爾的軍事法庭在1838至39年間審理了一百零八名被告，最終二十九人因叛國罪被處絞刑，五十八人被流放澳洲；整場叛亂英方損失合計一百二十二人，愛國者方面合計四百一十一人。關鍵日期依序為：1837年11月6日起事、11月23日聖丹尼、11月25日聖夏爾、12月14日聖厄斯達什，1838年2月22日共和國成立、2月28日羅伯特·納爾松在阿爾堡宣布獨立、4月拉卡托訖與聖夏爾兩役、11月3日第二次入侵、11月9日共和國終結、11月10日戰事結束。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked run roughly as follows. In time, the Lower Canada Rebellion ran from 6 November 1837 to 10 November 1838, and the Republic of Lower Canada existed from 22 February to 9 November 1838. At Saint-Denis on 23 November 1837 the British had three hundred regulars and one gun against two hundred militia and six hundred badly armed civilians; the British lost six killed, ten wounded, six missing and one gun, the Patriotes twelve dead and seven wounded. At Saint-Charles on 25 November the government had four hundred and six regular infantry, twenty militia cavalrymen and two guns against two hundred to two hundred and fifty men with fifty rifles; three British were killed and eighteen wounded, and fifty-six Patriotes were killed in a battle lasting about two hours. At Saint-Eustache on 14 December the government force was about fifteen hundred men, comprising one thousand two hundred and eighty regulars of the 1st and 32nd Regiments, the newly arrived 83rd Regiment, artillery and two hundred and twenty loyalist volunteers; the Patriotes in fact assembled only two hundred and one men. Three British were killed, seventy Patriotes killed and a hundred and twenty taken prisoner, in a fight that lasted at least four hours. Across the whole front the British had one thousand three hundred and eighty regulars, rising to about ten thousand by the middle of 1838, with thirty-three thousand colonial militia; the Patriotes had about four thousand one hundred men under arms and some twenty-five thousand sympathetic militia. On the suppression: the court martial at Montreal in 1838 and 1839 heard one hundred and eight accused, ending in twenty-nine executions for treason and the transportation of fifty-eight men to Australia; over the rebellion as a whole the British lost one hundred and twenty-two men and the Patriotes four hundred and eleven. The key dates in order are: 6 November 1837, the outbreak; 23 November, Saint-Denis; 25 November, Saint-Charles; 14 December, Saint-Eustache; 22 February 1838, the proclamation of the republic; 28 February, Robert Nelson's declaration of independence at Alburg; April, the actions at Lac-à-la-Tortue and Saint-Charles; 3 November, the second invasion; 9 November, the end of the republic; and 10 November, the end of the fighting.
cause: 起事的原因比上加拿大更深：不是一時的選舉失敗，而是三十年累積的殖民地位問題。一七九一年的憲法把下加拿大分成立法議會與由總督任命的立法局，掌權的是被後人稱為城堡集團的英裔商人與舊貴族，愛國者的選票再多也換不來一個能問責的政府；一八三二年蒙特利爾對示威者的開槍，以及天主教會與英方之間的關係，令法裔居民對自己的公民地位失去信心。領袖帕皮諾把這些不滿整理成文件：羅伯特·古萊征集的一百零九項怨情，經整理成為一八三四年一月七日提交立法議會的九十二條決議案，要求行政委員與總督向議會負責、廢除不合民情的土地與選舉安排。經濟層的壓力同樣直接：一八三〇年代中期霍亂、傷寒與痢疾隨移民進入殖民地，豆城、索迪爾與里歇利耶一帶的農田又遭小麥蠅、蝗蟲與毛蟲災害，產量銳減，佃農與農民既要面對歉收，又要面對地租、什一稅與新的徵稅；土地制度本身也是鬥爭對象，教區的保留地與永久地契的爭議使新一代無地者只能靠向外移民或向英裔買地。外部條件是美國的縱容與大西洋兩岸的共和思潮：美國政府對越境武裝長期採取不干涉政策，紐約州北部的漁民與走私網絡可以供應武器、渡船與藏身之地；而美國的共和記憶、歐洲的憲章運動與法國一八三〇年的革命餘波，都讓另立共和國成為一個可以公開討論的選項。
causeEn: The causes here ran deeper than in Upper Canada: this was not a single failed election but the accumulated position of the colony over thirty years. The Constitution of 1791 divided Lower Canada into an elected assembly and a legislative council appointed by the governor, and power lay with the English-speaking merchants and old seigneurial families whom later generations called the Château Clique; however many votes the Patriotes won, they could not obtain a government that answered to them. The shooting of demonstrators at Montreal in 1832, and the alignment of the Catholic Church with the English party, robbed French Canadians of confidence in their standing as citizens. Papineau turned the grievance into documents: the hundred and nine complaints collected by Robert Gourlay were distilled into the Ninety-Two Resolutions laid before the House of Assembly on 7 January 1834, asking that the executive council and the governor be made accountable to the assembly and that unpopular arrangements of land and representation be undone. The economic pressure was just as direct. In the middle of the 1830s cholera, typhus and dysentery arrived with the immigrants, and the farms of the Beauce, the Chaudière and the Richelieu were then ravaged by wheat fly, grasshoppers and caterpillars, so that yields fell sharply; the tenant farmer faced a bad harvest at the same time as rent, the tithe and new taxes. The land system was itself in dispute, and the question of the clergy reserves and of perpetual leases meant that a new generation without land could only move to the frontier or buy from the British. The external conditions were American indulgence and the republican current across the Atlantic: the United States government long followed a policy of non-intervention towards armed men who crossed the border, and the fishing and smuggling networks of northern New York could supply arms, ferries and places to hide; and the republican memory of the United States, the Chartist movement in Europe and the afterglow of the French Revolution of 1830 all made another republic a proposition that could be discussed in the open.
impact: 直接後果是下加拿大政局的長期重整與對愛國者記憶的官方化。鎮壓之後，原有的議會政治被凍結，總督與行政局的權力進一步收緊，英語派與天主教會在地方上取得更大份額；英國政府則派達勒姆勛爵赴任，報告建議把上下加拿大合併，於是一八四〇年成立加拿大省，愛國者的核心要求——責任內閣——最終於一八四九年落實，帕皮諾回到政治前台，一八五一年出任加拿大省聯合省總督，結束了流亡的生涯。文化上的影響更為長久：愛國者的旗幟與歌曲在後來成為魁北克國民記憶的一部分，一九二〇年代起，後來被定為法定假日愛國者日的五月廿四日取代了原來的國王生日，一九六〇年代後又被魁北克獨立運動吸收為自己的象徵；以愛國者為名的營在西班牙內戰中站在國民派一方，也是這段記憶在二十世紀的一次延伸。國際層面上，一八三八年之後英美在北美問題上的合作明顯加強，韋伯斯特－阿什伯頓條約解決了東北邊界與諾瓦斯科舍的權利爭議，紐約州與英屬北美之間的邊境也從此由常設的混合委員會管理，這套安排成為十九世紀北美邊界外交的樣板。此外，大量流放者被送往澳洲，其中一部分在悉尼的加拿大灣一帶落地成家。
impactEn: The direct consequences were a long reshaping of Lower Canadian politics and the official canonisation of the Patriote memory. After the repression the old parliamentary politics was frozen, the authority of the governor and the executive council tightened further, and the English party and the Catholic Church took a larger share of local power. The British government sent Lord Durham, whose report recommended joining the two Canadas, and the Province of Canada was created in 1840; the central Patriote demand of responsible government was granted in 1849; Papineau returned to the political front and in 1851 became premier of the united Province of Canada, ending his years in exile. The cultural consequences lasted longer. The flags and songs of the Patriotes became part of the Quebec national memory, and from the 1920s the twenty-fourth of May, later made the statutory holiday of Patriots' Day, replaced the monarch's birthday; from the 1960s it was taken over as a symbol by the Quebec independence movement, and the unit named for the Patriotes that fought on the Nationalist side in the Spanish Civil War carried that memory into the twentieth century. At the international level, Anglo-American cooperation over North American questions tightened after 1838; the Webster-Ashburton Treaty settled the northeastern boundary and the Nova Scotian claims, and the border between New York and British North America was thereafter administered by a standing joint commission, a pattern that became a model for nineteenth-century North American boundary diplomacy. A large number of those transported to Australia settled in the Canada Bay area of Sydney, and the name of a New Brunswick community still recalls the exiles.
result: 結果是愛國者運動在軍事上被徹底壓碎，在政治上卻成為未來改革的路徑。十二月十四日的聖厄斯達什是轉捩點：陳尼爾陣亡、七十名武裝者陣亡、一百二十人被俘，教堂與莊宅被燒，四小時的戰鬥之後里歇利耶河谷再無成建制的愛國者武力；政府的部隊隨後在聖夏爾、聖班努瓦等村莊搜捕，數百名首腦被捕，一百零八名被告在蒙利爾受軍法審判。鎮壓的後果由兩個方向組成：短期內是絞刑與流放，二十九人因叛國被處絞刑，五十八人被送往澳洲的流放地；長期內則是愛國者成為加拿大的建國記憶之一。戰事本身以一八三八年十一月十日結束，一八三八年二月至十一月的下加拿大共和國只存在了八個多月，其間羅伯特·納爾松在阿爾堡宣布獨立並被美軍拘押、陪審團判無罪，十月與十一月的兩度跨境入侵也都在登陸與補給階段瓦解。一八三九年達勒姆勛爵抵達並提交報告，一八四〇年兩省合併為加拿大省，愛國者的下一代在一八四〇年代把訴求從共和改為問責，這一轉變在加拿大政治史上留下的痕跡，比那幾場會戰更深。
resultEn: The result was that the Patriote movement was destroyed as a military force and turned into the path of future reform. Saint-Eustache on 14 December was the turning point: Chénier killed, seventy of the defenders killed, a hundred and twenty taken prisoner, the church and the manor houses burned, and after four hours of fighting there was no longer any organised Patriote force in the Richelieu valley. The government troops then swept the villages of Saint-Charles and Saint-Benoît, and hundreds of leaders were arrested, a hundred and eight accused tried before the court martial at Montreal. The consequences ran in two directions. In the short term, execution and transportation: twenty-nine men hanged for treason, fifty-eight sent to the penal settlements in Australia. In the long term, the Patriotes became one of the founding memories of Canada. The fighting itself ended on 10 November 1838. The Republic of Lower Canada of February to November 1838 lasted a little over eight months; in that time Robert Nelson proclaimed independence at Alburg and was arrested by the United States Army and acquitted by a sympathetic jury, and the two cross-border invasions of October and November collapsed at the stage of landing and supply. Lord Durham arrived in 1839 and filed his report, the two provinces were joined in 1840, and in the 1840s the next generation of Patriotes exchanged the demand for a republic for the demand for accountability. That exchange left a deeper mark on Canadian political history than the handful of engagements did.
